name: declared-keyword-participant-renamed
before:
sequenceDiagram
    participant Loop as Tile sorter
    participant J as paint()
    Loop->>J: paint(tile)
    J-->>Loop: result, color blue
after:
sequenceDiagram
    participant LoopActor as Tile sorter
    participant J as paint()
    LoopActor->>J: paint(tile)
    J-->>LoopActor: result, color blue
